children: Netflix’s new series “The Altruists” has stirred discussion in the crypto community, with 1confirmation founder Nick Tomaino revisiting the FTX collapse. According to Odaily, Tomaino said mainstream media outlets including The New York Times and CNBC, along with crypto industry commentators, overstated FTX’s standing to attract attention, calling it the best crypto exchange and describing Sam Bankman-Fried as the “JPMorgan of crypto.”

Tomaino also criticized former U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission Chair Gary Gensler and politicians who received FTX political donations, saying they met with the company to discuss a no-action letter and received more than $100 million in funds. He said Sequoia Capital and other venture firms invested more than $1.8 billion in the company despite its fraudulent conduct.
Tomaino said the FTX case showed that highly regarded individuals and institutions can exhibit intense greed, adding that the industry should reflect on the lack of limits revealed by the episode.

title: Netflix’s FTX Series Prompts Industry Reflection; 1confirmation Founder Criticizes Former SEC Chair and Sequoia
